listing.name: 3D Dot Game Heroes — pc-3ddotgameheroes (vs-sr-dev)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Fourlogos/firstflip then blackscreen lookingforsave; no menu/gameplay established; concrete early native title runtime. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: PS3 Europe BLES00875 your own 3D Dot Game Heroes disc/EBOOT plus user keyfile; exactrevision frommanifest. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: OwnISO extract/decrypt, the declared flash replacement, ps3kit staticemit/CMake then local ps3boot. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
